title: SG-6.4.2 · Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
summary: ExecutionPanel gets an optional onReject prop and a Reject button shown only when the run is awaiting approval.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx already renders Approve (AWAITING_APPROVAL, onApprove) and Retry (FAILED, onRetry), and api/client.ts already has rejectExecution. Desired behavior: add an optional onReject prop and a Reject button visible only when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject is provided. Expected result: clicking Reject calls onReject with the execution id. Why: the admin must be able to reject a publication from the panel. AdminApp wiring is out of scope (SG-6.4 sibling).
acceptance_criteria: Given an execution with status AWAITING_APPROVAL and an onReject prop, when ExecutionPanel renders, then a button named Reject is shown
Given the Reject button is clicked, when the click handler runs, then onReject is called once with the execution id
Given a status other than AWAITING_APPROVAL (FAILED, RUNNING), when ExecutionPanel renders, then no Reject button is shown
Given AWAITING_APPROVAL but no onReject prop, when ExecutionPanel renders, then no Reject button is shown and Approve still works

in_scope: ExecutionPanel onReject prop and Reject button

technical_constraints: onReject is optional so existing callers compile unchanged
definition_of_done: Reject button implemented per acceptance criteria
